statements: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "graph_ref" (id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, graph TEXT NOT NULL, root_id TEXT NOT NULL, parent_ref_id TEXT REFERENCES "graph_ref" (id), base_commit_id TEXT REFERENCES "graph_commit" (id), head_commit_id TEXT REFERENCES "graph_commit" (id), name TEXT NOT NULL, sealed_at INTEGER, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_by TEXT NOT NULL, deleted_at INTEGER, deleted_by TEXT, _version INTEGER NOT NULL) STRICT
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "graph_ref_live_name" ON "graph_ref" (graph, root_id, name) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "graph_ref_history" (history_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, graph TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, _version INTEGER NOT NULL, operation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (operation IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE')), data TEXT NOT NULL, recorded_at INTEGER NOT NULL) STRICT
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "graph_ref_history_version" ON "graph_ref_history" (id, _version)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "graph_commit" (id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, graph TEXT NOT NULL, root_id TEXT NOT NULL, ref_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "graph_ref" (id), parent_commit_id TEXT REFERENCES "graph_commit" (id), message TEXT, schema_epoch INTEGER NOT NULL, content_hash TEXT NOT NULL, sequence INTEGER, created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "graph_commit_sequence" ON "graph_commit" (graph, root_id, sequence)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "graph_patch" (id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, graph TEXT NOT NULL, commit_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "graph_commit" (id), entity_kind TEXT NOT NULL, entity_key TEXT NOT NULL, entity_id TEXT NOT NULL, entity_version INTEGER NOT NULL, operation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (operation IN ('ADD', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE'))) STRICT
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "graph_patch_entity" ON "graph_patch" (commit_id, entity_kind, entity_key)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "graph_patch_pin" ON "graph_patch" (entity_id, entity_version)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "graph_snapshot_entry" (id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, graph TEXT NOT NULL, commit_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "graph_commit" (id), entity_kind TEXT NOT NULL, entity_key TEXT NOT NULL, entity_id TEXT NOT NULL, entity_version INTEGER NOT NULL) STRICT
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "graph_snapshot_entry_entity" ON "graph_snapshot_entry" (commit_id, entity_kind, entity_key)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "graph_snapshot_entry_pin" ON "graph_snapshot_entry" (entity_id, entity_version)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "graph_release" (id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, graph TEXT NOT NULL, root_id TEXT NOT NULL, commit_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "graph_commit" (id), created_at INTEGER NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL, updated_by TEXT NOT NULL, _version INTEGER NOT NULL) STRICT
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "graph_release_root" ON "graph_release" (graph, root_id)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "graph_release_history" (history_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, graph TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, _version INTEGER NOT NULL, operation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (operation IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE')), data TEXT NOT NULL, recorded_at INTEGER NOT NULL) STRICT
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "graph_release_history_version" ON "graph_release_history" (id, _version)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "graph_member" (id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, graph TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, entity_key TEXT NOT NULL, ref_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES "graph_ref" (id), root_id TEXT NOT NULL, tombstone INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (tombstone IN (0, 1)), _version INTEGER NOT NULL, data TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "graph_member_entity" ON "graph_member" (graph, kind, ref_id, entity_key)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "graph_member_history" (history_id TEXT NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY, graph TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, _version INTEGER NOT NULL, operation TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (operation IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE')), data TEXT NOT NULL, recorded_at INTEGER NOT NULL) STRICT
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "graph_member_history_version" ON "graph_member_history" (id, _version)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS "graph_member_history_recorded" ON "graph_member_history" (graph, kind, recorded_at)
